description: Deep stars: real stars beyond the HYG catalogue. deep-stars-a.bin: apparent magnitude <= 10 from the Sun, or more luminous than M = -3; deep-stars-b.bin: the rest. Format MWDS v1 (tools/milkyway/volumes/deep-stars.mjs). Brightness is the observed one (dust towards the star included as seen from the Sun). Derived from AT-HYG: CC BY-SA 4.0.

sources.cite: AT-HYG v4.0 (Augmented Tycho - HYG), David Nash (astronexus), subset to magnitude 11
Zari et al. 2021, A&A 650, A112 (Mapping luminous hot stars in the Galaxy), filtered sample
